jobs.title: Instrumentation Project Manager (New York, NY or Baltimore, MD)
jobs.location: New York, United States of America; On-site
jobs.description:
Geocomp, Inc. is a uniquely integrated company providing services and products to help clients identify and manage risk associated with infrastructure design, construction, and operation. With over 40 years of experience, Geocomp is well-positioned to help clients on a wide range of projects, providing geostructural consulting, monitoring, and laboratory testing services worldwide. Geocomp also manufactures, sells, and offers expert technical support for our fully automated laboratory testing systems to commercial, research, and academic labs, globally. 
 Job Details  
 Geocomp is seeking a Project Manager experienced in geotechnical instrumentation and monitoring of heavy civil construction projects to join our team in New York, NY or Baltimore, MD. 
 This role involves the design of instrumentation and monitoring programs, monitoring of construction activities, data interpretation, report preparation, and client relationship management.
 About the Team
 When you join Geocomp, you will become part of a collaborative team focused on delivering best practices and innovative solutions for complex infrastructure projects. We offer a supportive environment that encourages personal excellence, integrity, and continuous learning. We are looking for professionals who enjoy delivering value-based solutions for clients and who have a desire to learn, grow, and take initiative. Those who are self-motivated and thrive in a collaborative environment will find excellent opportunities for professional development at Geocomp.
 Key Responsibilities
 Design instrumentation systems.
 Coordinate and support the field installation of instrumentation equipment.
 Perform ongoing evaluation of monitoring data and the status of instrumentation systems.
 Prepare instrumentation bids and technical proposals.
 Manage project staff and coordinate field activities related to the installation, maintenance, and monitoring of instrumentation systems.
 Prepare technical reports, including the interpretation of instrumentation data.
 Promote positive health and safety practices, ensuring company and project standards are met.
 Build and maintain strong client relationships while meeting project objectives and client expectations.
 Qualifications 
 Required​
 Master of Science in Civil Engineering with a major in Geotechnical Engineering.
 Minimum of 7+ years of consulting experience working directly with clients, including 4+ years of experience in structural and geotechnical instrumentation.
 Strong working knowledge of the installation and monitoring of prisms, AMTS units, seismographs, inclinometers, tilt meters, data loggers, observation wells, boring inspections, strain gauges, extensometers, borehole instrumentation, and web-based data management systems.
 Proven experience preparing bids for general contractors and technical proposals.
 Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with colleagues and multidisciplinary teams.
 Strong time and people management skills.
 Excellent client relationship skills with a strong commitment to client service.
 Willingness to travel and spend time on project sites during critical project stages.
 Preferred
 Professional Engineer (PE) license in the State of New York.
 Benefits Package
 401(k) with company match
 Comprehensive health insurance
 Health Savings Account (HSA)
 Paid Time Off (PTO)
 Professional development assistance
 Employee referral program
 Our Hiring Process 
 At Geocomp, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience.
 Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond.
 We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly.
 We see things differently. Diversity fuels our innovation, we value the unique ways in which we differ, and we are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

jobs.description:
SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide. 
 Job Description Summary: 
The Project Manager is responsible for overall management of Substation construction/operation resulting in successful project execution. 
This role can be fully remote or based full-time in our office in Edison, NJ or Albany, NY. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process. 
 Job Description: 
 *This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned 
 Position Responsibilities and Duties:   
 Execute all responsibilities of a Project Engineer with deep focus on substation design, construction, testing, and energization 
 Review Power Purchase Agreements, Generator Interconnection Agreements, Utility Interconnection Requirements, Contract Documents, System Impact Studies, Facility Studies, and Owner/Engineer specifications to ensure compliance of substation scope 
 Oversee LNTP and Early-Stage deliverables for HV and substation-specific workstreams, ensuring alignment with permitting and utility interconnection timelines 
 Develop, manage, and track the substation budget, including primary equipment procurement, civil sitework, grounding systems, protection & control, SCADA integration, and construction labor 
 Create detailed subcontractor scopes of work related to substation EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) including testing and commissioning 
 Lead and manage substation subcontractors—including RFI coordination, billing reviews, change orders, daily reporting, safety performance, and schedule tracking 
 Monitor and control substation scope changes and associated commercial impacts 
 Facilitate and participate in Project Kick-Off Meetings, with dedicated discussion on substation milestones and risks 
 Manage and collect RFIs and submittals with substation relevance, coordinating with engineering and construction teams for resolution 
 Lead Utility Coordination Meetings focused on relay settings, protection schemes, testing protocols, switching orders, and managing the interconnection process 
 Participate in Owner Coordination Meetings to communicate substation progress, risks, and technical issues 
 Engage in SE team meetings to coordinate interdependence between PV, BESS, and substation infrastructure 
 Oversee material procurement efforts—particularly long-lead substation components such as power transformers, breakers, steel structures, control enclosures, relays, and communication systems 
 Facilitate construction schedule and scope review meetings, highlighting critical paths for substation construction and energization 
 Lead site Kick-Off Meetings, Pre-Commissioning Walks, and Energization Readiness Reviews specific to HV equipment 
 Coordinate PV and substation energization support including relay testing, functional checkouts, and utility witness testing 
 Manage Final Completion Punchlist for all substation-related work and documentation (redlines, test reports, as-builts, relay settings, etc.) 
 Ensure a safe work environment and enforce safety practices around energized substations and high-voltage equipment 
 Maintain flexible availability for substation construction and commissioning events, which may occur outside regular business hours 
 Regular travel required to project sites, utility offices, and vendor facilities 
 Support continuous improvement, lessons learned, and standardization efforts across substation projects 
 Complete additional responsibilities as assigned 
 Objectives or Goals to Measure Performance:  
 Adherence to company procedures, safety manuals, and substation-specific safety protocols 
 Substation scope completion on schedule and within budget 
 High performance and coordination across engineering, construction, and subcontractor teams 
 Utility and Owner satisfaction with substation delivery and commissioning outcomes 
 Compliance with interconnection agreements and regulatory standards 
 Minimal change orders, RFIs, or rework on substation scope 
 Timely procurement and delivery of long-lead HV equipment 
 Positive contribution to team morale, training, and development 
 Advancement of internal best practices for substation project management 
 Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements  
 Minimum 5 years of experience in substation design, construction, or commissioning of utility-scale or industrial high-voltage (69kV to 500kV) systems 
 Experience with working withing the Norh East Region of the country 
 Proven ability to lead multi-disciplinary substation projects through full lifecycle—from kickoff to energization 
 Familiarity with substation components: transformers, circuit breakers, switchgear, grounding, control buildings, protection & control, relays, SCADA, etc. 
 Experience managing Transmission Line construction  
 Licensed Professional Engineer (PE) or Project Management Professional (PMP) preferred 
 NFPA 70E “Qualified Person” preferred; must be familiar with energized work practices and LOTO protocols 
 Strong interpersonal and communication skills to manage client, utility, and subcontractor interfaces 
 Ability to identify, prioritize, and resolve project challenges with limited supervision 
 Working knowledge of utility operations, switching procedures, relay testing, and energization protocols 
 Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite; P6 scheduling experience preferred 
 Experience with CAD, PDF markup tools, and field documentation platforms is a plus 
 Physical Demands and Environmental Conditions:  
 Requires frequent walking, bending, standing, and lifting (20+ lbs) on uneven terrain at construction sites 
 Ability to visually inspect and verify HV equipment installations, conduct site walks, and observe electrical testing safely 
 Occasional climbing, working at heights, or accessing substation steel platforms

 Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.  
 Our Clinical Development model brings the customer and the patient to the center of everything that we do. We are continuously looking for ways to simplify and streamline our work to not only make Syneos Health easier to work with, but to make us easier to work for.
 Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to accelerate the delivery of therapies, because we are passionate to change lives.
 Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know: 
 WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE 
 Why Syneos Health
 We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
 We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people. 
 We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong. 
 Job Responsibilities 
 The Project Manager is responsible for leading Real-World Evidence (RWE) research projects from initiation through delivery, partnering closely with clients, epidemiologists, research teams, and biostatisticians to ensure successful project execution.
 This role combines project leadership, scientific understanding, and client consulting. The successful candidate will not only manage timelines and deliverables but will also provide strategic recommendations, facilitate client discussions, proactively solve problems, and contribute to the overall success of RWE research programs.
 The ideal candidate brings experience in Real-World Evidence, health research, consulting, or other highly client-facing environments and is comfortable navigating ambiguity while managing multiple stakeholders.
 Ideal Background
 3-4 years of project management, consulting, or research management experience
 Experience supporting Real-World Evidence (RWE) projects
 Experience with database studies, qualitative research, quantitative research, and interview-based studies
 Scientific background in Epidemiology, Public Health, Health Sciences, Life Sciences, or related fields
 Strong client-facing and consulting skills
 Experience presenting recommendations and guiding decision-making discussions
 Ability to work effectively with epidemiologists, biostatisticians, and research teams
 Comfortable working in a global and cross-functional environment
 Important Note for Applicants
 This position is focused on Real-World Evidence (RWE) research and is not a traditional clinical trial management role . Candidates whose experience is primarily focused on Phase I-III clinical trials, CRA activities, site monitoring, or clinical operations may not be the best fit unless they also have substantial exposure to Real-World Evidence research and consulting-based project delivery.

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

 This role helps implement and manage ePRO and other patient technologies across Pfizer R&D. You will be a member of the Patient Data Strategies team, build processes, and resources for study teams, and own sub-projects that support high-quality, low risk ePRO use. You will work independently within a collaborative team.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Work as a key member of the Patient Data Strategies Team to source stakeholder input and initiate, develop and maintain process and technology tools as required.
 Serve as support resource to Clinical Data and Information Sciences, Global Site and Study Operations, and Pfizer R&D colleagues.
 Interact as directed with Business/Research Units to identify specific needs for ePRO and Mobile Health support
 Resolve conflicts and communicate with, and influence, key stakeholders and user groups.
 Collaborate with key departments within Pfizer R&D
 Identify, initiate, and support solutions that allow study teams to implement ePRO and other patient-based technologies.
 Participate in and may lead initiatives to standardize elements of ePRO, eConsent  across Pfizer’s portfolio.
 Research allied technologies, vendor services and assist in developing expertise and forming a future expanded vision of patient-based technology usage within Pfizer.
 Assist with audits and inspections
 Engage external resources as required to develop internal patient technology functions and support.
 Conduct independent needs-based research to expand patient technologies’ knowledge and determine how technology implementation fits within boundaries of the sponsor rules and federal regulations.
 MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 
 MBA/MS and 5+ years of clinical development experience OR 
 Bachelors degree in a scientific, technical or business discipline and 6+ years of clinical development experience
 2+ years of experience with clinical technologies (e.g., eCOA (electronic Clinical Outcome Assessments) )
 Good understanding of the processes associated with clinical study management, data management, and regulatory operations
 Process development and execution experience
 Experience in the following areas:
 PRO technologies
 Process Management
 Change Management
 eConsent
 Mobile Technologies
 Mobile App usage and Deployment
 Medical Devices
 Strong communication skills—Written, verbal and presentation
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATION 
 Inspection and audit experience

 Job Description : 
 Summary 
The Project Manager is responsible for the management of one or more projects. Must have a thorough understanding of project management methodologies and execute the same in strict accordance with the standards defined by the Ryder PMO. This position will interact with business partners and cross-functional teams to ensure project objectives are achieved on time and within budget. PMO Project Managers are expected to report progress to all stakeholders, identify early warning signs and effectively communicate status and trend of their projects. PMO Project Managers escalate issues to executive steering committee members, facilitate decision making, document decisions and communicate direction to project team accordingly. Travel may be required on some projects.
 Essential Functions 
 Manage project plan, track dependencies, address constraints, resolve resource conflicts, assess impacts to plan, obtain estimates to complete forecast use of funds, ensure adherence to SDLC, report progress against plan.
 Develop and execute project communications plan, facilitate team meetings, participate in key meetings that directly or indirectly impact the project, keep project stakeholders informed, prepare for and conduct executive steering committee meetings.
 Gather content from respective project team members to complete interim and final deliverables. Present deliverables required at respective tollgates throughout the project live cycle. Obtain sign-off and approvals to proceed for stakeholders. Maintain project team repository of deliverables, reference materials and documentation. Prepare change requests as agreed to by project team and obtain signatures from project owner and sponsor.
 Prepare weekly status reports, track open issues, update risks (probability, severity and impact) and mitigation plans. Participate in PMO meetings with other Project Managers to identify potential dependencies or constraints.
 Manage project budget, maintain financial plan, track actuals vs. plan, provide monthly forecasts, and report monthly accruals.

 Monitor and report to IT and process/function owner on the status of multiple concurrent project efforts.
 Provide analytical expertise within an assigned business unit/area in the analysis, design and development of business applications.
 Develop business relationships and integrate activities with other IT departments to ensure successful implementation and support of project efforts.
 Evaluate application software packages and make recommendations to management.
 Participate with other IT members, customers and stake holders in new product reviews, tests and pilots.
 Collect and analyze business requirements for large, multi-functional projects.
 Lead project teams through feasibility studies, translating requirements into an appropriate design.
 Foster and maintain good relationships with customers and IT colleagues to meet expected customer service levels.
 Perform other duties as assigned.
 Skills and Abilities 
 Leadership skills that engage multi-discipline work teams to respond to business needs
 Strong project management skills with experience in organizing, planning and executing large-scale projects from vision to implementation involving internal personnel, contractors and vendors
 Must possess excellent human resource management skills
 Strong analytical, problem-solving and conceptual skills
 Ability to work on cross-functional project teams and foster team commitment to tasks

 Strong oral, interpersonal and written communications skills with an ability to express complex technical concepts in business terms
 Must be capable of providing cross-functional teams briefing as needed
 Ability to create and maintain professional relationships within all levels of the organization (peers, work groups, customers, supervisors)
 Ability to work independently and as a member of a team
 Flexibility to operate and self-driven to excel in a fast-paced environment
 Capable of multi-tasking, highly organized, responsible, reliable pro-active self-starter requiring minimal supervision, with excellent time management skills

Help Build the Data Foundation Behind JAX's Growth 
 The Jackson Laboratory's Business Transformation Office (BTO) sits at the center of some of the most strategic work happening across the organization — from enterprise growth initiatives to mergers and acquisitions supporting JAX Mice and Clinical Research Services (JMCRS). 
 We're looking for an Associate Project Manager, Data Governance to help keep that transformation work on track and our enterprise data accurate, trusted, and well-governed.
 This role is part project manager, part data governance analyst — a great fit for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex, cross-functional work and wants hands-on exposure to both program delivery and the data practices that let a growing organization scale with confidence. You'll report to the Director of Business Data Governance & Stewardship, partnering closely with data owners, stewards, and both business and IT teams, with room to work independently as your experience grows.
 Fully remote with travel as needed to JAX locations, approximately 15%
 What You'll Do 
 Project Management 
 Build and maintain project plans, timelines, and resource allocations
 Facilitate meetings, document decisions, and drive follow-through on action items
 Track progress, flag risks, and prepare clear status reports for stakeholders
 Coordinate across internal teams and external vendors to keep projects aligned
 Contribute to change management and continuous improvement across BTO initiatives
 Data Governance Program Management 
 Drive execution of data governance plans, release milestones, and decision logs
 Facilitate governance workflows — issue intake, triage, remediation, and closure
 Coordinate user acceptance testing and release readiness for master data releases
 Build documentation and training materials that help data owners understand governance expectations
 Support the expansion of the governance model into new domains as the program matures
 Data Governance Analysis & Stewardship 
 Analyze data quality trends, identify root causes, and recommend fixes
 Report governance and data quality metrics through Lean visual scorecards (e.g., bowling charts)
 Support master data management efforts — match/merge logic, survivorship rules, hierarchy management
 Maintain the business glossary and critical data element definitions
 What You Bring (Requirements) 
 Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Data Management, Business, Analytics, or a related field
 4+ years of combined experience across project management and data governance, data management, or analytics
 Working knowledge of data governance concepts (stewardship, ownership, data quality, metadata, lineage) and MDM fundamentals (golden records, match/merge, survivorship, hierarchies)
 Experience coordinating cross-functional project work — plans, timelines, risk, and reporting — in a matrixed organization
 Nice to Have 
 Familiarity with Lean visual management, A3 problem solving, or another continuous improvement method
 Experience in life sciences, biomedical research, healthcare, or another regulated environment
 Experience supporting enterprise transformation or data modernization initiatives
 Master's degree in a related field
 PMP, CAPM, CDMP, or SAFe/Lean certification
 Tools You May Work With: Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, Jira, or Asana; Power BI and Excel; MDM platforms such as Informatica or Profisee; Salesforce or Dynamics 365; Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Excel, PowerPoint)
 Salary Range : $80,167 – $116,242 based on years of related experience and internal equity considerations
 About JAX: 
 The Jackson Laboratory is an independent, nonprofit biomedical research institution with a National Cancer Institute-designated Cancer Center and nearly 3,000 employees in locations across the United States (Maine, Connecticut, California, New York, Florida), Japan and China. Its mission is to discover precise genomic solutions for disease and empower the global biomedical community in the shared quest to improve human health.
 Founded in 1929, JAX applies over nine decades of expertise in genetics to increase understanding of human disease, advancing treatments and cures for cancer, neurological and immune disorders, diabetes, aging and heart disease. It models and interprets genomic complexity, integrates basic research with clinical application, educates current and future scientists, and provides critical data, tools and services to the global biomedical community. For more information, please visit  www.jax.org​​​​​​​ .

 Job Description 
 Join our colleagues in bringing our mission to life every single day, enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.
 Our Fisher Healthcare business serves the lab diagnostics industry through its strong brands and commercial footprint, and we are growing our presence across the care continuum. We are seeking a curious, self-motivated data analyst who loves turning marketing and commercial data into insight and has the project management discipline to carry that insight through to action.
 You will serve as the dedicated analytics and delivery partner to the Fisher Healthcare Digital Marketing team, owning that relationship end to end, from intake and prioritization through delivery, reporting, and benefit realization. You will also take on commercially focused initiatives across the broader business, applying the same rigor to questions of sales performance, pricing, and growth. This role reports into the PMO through the Sr. Manager, Programs & Operations, with a dotted line to the Sr. Manager, Market Intelligence, in support of the group's broader data and analytics strategy.
 Your center of gravity will be analytics, spanning marketing and commercial data alike. You will deliver the dashboards, insights, and recommendations that explain what happened, why it happened, and what we should do next, whether the question comes from digital marketing performance, organic search, or transactional and finance data. You will guide strategic direction on SEO while global team members and external partners carry out execution.
 Great analysis only matters if it becomes action, and that is where your project management skills come in. You will manage a portfolio of marketing and commercial initiatives as your own book of business, from detailed weekly execution through the portfolio-level reporting that keeps status, funding, and progress visible to leadership and connected to planning across the business. You will bring options and recommendations rather than simple status updates, helping your partners make faster, more informed decisions.
 This is not a role where you settle into a routine. Business needs shift quickly, and the scope of this role will evolve with them. We are looking for someone who is comfortable in ambiguity, treats their work like their own business, owns their relationships and workstreams with minimal oversight, and drives change instead of simply reporting on it.
 This role can be based remotely anywhere throughout Eastern or Central US time zones.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Marketing Analytics & Insights: Build Power BI dashboards and reporting ready for leadership; ensure the accuracy, tagging, and flow of data across Adobe Analytics, Eloqua, and Salesforce, and translate performance across channels and campaigns into clear, actionable recommendations.
 Commercial Analytics: Analyze transactional and finance data to support sales performance, pricing, and growth initiatives; use SQL and Databricks to model and pull data from our enterprise data platform, and deliver insights that shape commercial decisions.
 SEO Strategy & Direction: Lead organic search insight generation using tools such as Semrush; diagnose traffic and visibility trends, identify root causes, and set direction for global team members, contractors, and consultants, then report on how efforts are materializing.
 Measurement Integrity: Standardize campaign structure, tagging, and tracking across email and digital channels; partner with operations, marketing automation, and creative teams to verify each step works end to end so reporting is consistent and reliable.
 Segmentation & Journey Analysis: Develop segmentation, funnel, and journey analyses leveraging Salesforce/CRM data to understand customer groups, account structures, and behavior across the healthcare care continuum.
 Project Management: Manage marketing and commercial initiatives end to end, from intake and prioritization through execution and benefit tracking; build weekly project plans in Smartsheet and Excel while keeping portfolio status, funding, and milestones current in Workfront for visibility across the division.
 Reporting & Decision Support: Communicate status, deadlines, tradeoffs, risks, and plans to get back to green proactively; frame decisions with options and recommendations, and present to leadership with confidence.
 Collaboration & Continuous Improvement: Build productive relationships across divisional and corporate teams in a large matrixed organization, and streamline reporting and analysis through automation and Generative AI tools.
 Job Requirements 
 Education: 
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent, ideally with focused training in data or marketing analytics.
 Experience: 
 5+ years of relevant data analytics experience across marketing and commercial domains, including project management of your own workstreams.
 Proven proficiency with Power BI, SQL, Databricks, Adobe Analytics, Eloqua or comparable marketing automation platforms, Salesforce.com or other enterprise CRMs, and Generative AI tools.
 Experience working with transactional and finance data, including modeling and pulling data from enterprise data platforms.
 SEO and organic search analysis experience with tools such as Semrush; able to interpret trends and set direction rather than simply pulling reports.
 Experience managing projects at both the execution level, with detailed plans in tools like Smartsheet and Excel, and the portfolio level, in enterprise work management systems such as Workfront, including intake, prioritization, and status reporting.
 Experience in healthcare, diagnostics, or medical distribution is a plus; familiarity with healthcare account structures, contract membership (CMTs), GPO/IDN relationships, and healthcare data is a material advantage.
 Skills/Abilities: 
 Strong analytical and data skills, with proven ability to transform marketing and commercial data into meaningful, actionable initiatives that support business growth; an innovative problem solver with an outstanding customer first mentality.
 Disciplined project management: organized, accountable, and able to keep multiple workstreams on track at both a detailed and portfolio level. Familiarity with Agile and Six Sigma is an advantage.
 Self-motivated with an owner's mindset; able to weigh tradeoffs, form a recommendation, and move work forward with minimal direction, adapting as business needs shift.
 Collaborative influencer with superb communication and presentation skills; builds trust across corporate and divisional teams and can direct extended teams and vendors without formal authority.

As part of the GE HealthCare MR organization, the USCAN MR Clinical AI Implementation Specialist – icobrain will be responsible for leading the successful deployment of icobrain at customer sites across the U.S. and Canada, from project kickoff through go-live and handoff to ongoing support.
This is a newly created role, added to support the continued growth of icobrain within GE HealthCare MR. The successful candidate will join the existing icobrain Implementation Specialist in USCAN, sharing the customer implementation workload and helping to strengthen and scale how implementations are delivered.
This role sits at the intersection of technology and clinical workflow. The successful candidate will plan and execute technical software implementations, connecting icobrain's cloud-based platform with customer MR scanners, PACS, and RIS environments through DICOM and HL7, while making sure each deployment fits the way the customer's MR department works day to day.
The role operates within a matrixed organization, reporting into GE HealthCare MR while dedicated specifically to icobrain. The Implementation Specialist will partner closely with their fellow icobrain Implementation Specialist, MR Sales, the Clinical AI Sales Specialist, Customer Success, icometrix product and support teams, GE HealthCare service and IT/security teams, and customer stakeholders. Across all of these relationships, the customer always comes first.
Because icobrain is a growing part of the GE HealthCare MR portfolio, this role will also help formulate and document the implementation process itself, building the repeatable workflows, playbooks, and standards that allow the team to scale.
This is a primarily remote role, with most implementation activity, including kickoffs, configuration, testing, and customer meetings, conducted virtually through phone and Microsoft Teams. Travel to customer sites will be required as needed for key milestones such as go-lives, workflow assessments, and escalations.
The ideal candidate brings a client-first mindset to every interaction and is self-motivated, proactive, and highly organized, someone who takes control of issues and is eager to drive them to resolution.

 Integrate icobrain into the customer environment: Configure and validate DICOM connectivity and routing between MR scanners, PACS, and the icobrain cloud platform, and support HL7 interfaces and RIS integration for orders and results as required.
 Align the solution with MR department workflow: Work with MR technologists, radiologists, neuroradiologists, and imaging leaders to understand current workflows, protocols, and reading practices, and configure icobrain to fit seamlessly into them.
 Navigate security and IT requirements: Partner with customer IT and information security teams on security questionnaires, network and gateway configuration, firewall and access requirements, and data privacy reviews, including HIPAA and applicable Canadian privacy requirements.
 Take ownership and drive to resolution: Proactively identify risks, troubleshoot technical issues, and coordinate across customer and internal teams to resolve them quickly, keeping projects on schedule and stakeholders informed.
 Formulate and document processes: Working with the existing Implementation Specialist, help design, standardize, and document implementation processes, checklists, playbooks, and best practices for icobrain in USCAN, and continuously refine them based on lessons learned.
 Build relationships, internally and externally: Develop trusted relationships with customer clinical, IT, and administrative stakeholders and with GE HealthCare MR Sales, Clinical AI Sales, Customer Success, service, and product teams, always keeping the customer's needs at the center.
 Manage multiple projects with discipline: Track milestones, risks, actions, and documentation in established tools, and provide clear, timely status updates to customers and internal leadership.

 Bring the voice of the customer back to the organization: Share implementation insights, recurring technical issues, and customer feedback with Product, Customer Success, and MR leadership to improve both the product and the implementation experience.

 Understanding of RIS and PACS systems and how they interact within radiology workflow.
 Knowledge of healthcare IT security and privacy , including network security, access controls, security questionnaires, and HIPAA.
 Proven project management skills, with the ability to run multiple implementations at the same time and keep them on track.
 An excellent client-first mindset , with a track record of building trusted relationships with customers while working effectively with internal teams.
 Self-motivated and proactive, comfortable taking control of a situation and eager to drive issues to resolution with minimal direction.
 Highly organized, with strong documentation skills and experience creating or improving processes, playbooks, or standard work.
 Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to clinical, IT, and business audiences.
 Ability to work effectively in a matrixed organization , collaborating across MR, icobrain, Customer Success, service, and product teams while maintaining ownership of assigned implementations.
